dataset: UCM train only for rewards. Reuse frozen 24 train photos in previous order, 210 validation photos / 1050 caption owners and the existing 16-photo, two-wording, upright/180-degree rotation panel. No formal test.
source: Previous matched pilot and historical UCM deployment adapter. Same frozen downstream retriever and tools, image order and generation settings. Select no best checkpoint.
reward: Mean of within-group midranks for native image-caption margin and verified same-scene relation margin. Let S=(rank_mean-1)/7. Off reward S, on reward S+r_format(decoded generated rounds). r_format is the original project's exact 0/0.2 complete answer-tag rule. Compute equivalently in original rank units as rank_mean+7*r_format and group-standardize both arms as in the original pilot. No gradient from labels or feedback tokens; keep optimizer fixed.
primary: At step 24 report each seed and equal-seed average on-minus-off for native six-recall mR, immediate EOS and both-view greedy relation accuracy. Diagnostic intermediate steps 6 and 12 are never chosen on val for promotion. Base shared. Compare candidate to base and matched control in each seed.
retention_rule: Consider promotion only if step-24 format-on reaches at least the historical mR and both-view score in each seed and improves on its matched control for at least one of these, without decreasing the other. Label format a consistent reduction in early stopping only if its native EOS count is lower for both training seeds.
secondary: Identical common-query retrieval on all 210 photos. Monitor used tools, generation lengths, completed answers, six recalls, source-paired query bootstrap with fixed gallery (20,000 repeats), paired same-source two-seed mean, and counts by training step. Bootstrap does not quantify new training seeds.
diagnostic: In the second training seed's two step-24 policies, mask both EOS tokens only for the first generated token of the first round, holding query, image, weights, all later decoding and readout fixed. Re-evaluate full native retrieval and both-view detail; compare to each policy's native greedy deployment. Greedy baseline and standard evaluations reuse archived inputs. This is an intervention on decoding, not a revised trained policy.
paired_numerics: Training uses PyTorch deterministic algorithms, CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8 and disables cuDNN benchmark. Compare two separately loaded step-3 prefixes and active parameter signatures for seed A. At each full training step record active LoRA digest and verify identical on/off weights and candidates until the first differential format signal. The earlier default-kernel attempt is a separate numerical control.
